strings.string: Used for power zones. The Edge cannot share its own power zones with Connect IQ.
The cadence tile is green inside this range, blue below it and orange above.
Hex colour, RRGGBB. A leading # is allowed. Anything else falls back to the built-in colour.
Rows separated by ";", fields by spaces. Wrap a row in "=" for the status strip. Empty = built-in layout.
